purpose: One locked analysis-held-out October validation of the past-only adaptive commitment guard. These are historical sessions newly acquired for this study, not a real-time prospective deployment; they must not be used to choose the controller, learning rate, metrics, or scenario assumptions.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in use the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture. The later disconnectTime is a hidden environment event and must never be a controller input.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from the primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy, not historical delivered energy.

commitment_uncertainty.deployment_rule: At plug-in use April calibration scores plus only actual unplug outcomes observed at or before that control step.
commitment_uncertainty.selection_protocol: Learning rate 0.005 was selected from May candidates {0.005, 0.01, 0.02} by coverage-first selection and then replicated unchanged on June. Freeze all settings before obtaining or evaluating October sessions.
commitment_uncertainty.scope: Operational past-only adaptive guard; coverage is evaluated empirically and is not a finite-sample, per-driver, or conditional guarantee.

adaptive_conformal.reference: Gibbs and Candès (NeurIPS 2021), Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift. Bounded alpha is an explicit implementation safety choice.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real ACN sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations; this is an explicit experiment assumption.

solar_data.note: Approximate Caltech/Pasadena solar-resource proxy; it is not measured rooftop PV output.

pv_proxy_sensitivity.note: PVWatts GHI proxy for controlled sensitivity experiments; it is not measured Caltech PV production.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Deliberately severe shared feeder-import budget to create scarcity; it is not Caltech's measured feeder limit.
